state.purpose: Background on AI security risks for a blog post
state.text: Indirect prompt injection happens when a web page contains text such as 'ignore your previous instructions' that a browsing assistant later reads. Researchers showed in 2023 that assistants summarising such pages could be steered. Defences include treating fetched text as data and screening it before use.
